fact: Z. Mayet and Associates says Lesotho's Data Protection Act (Act No. 5 of 2012) is the law in force and has SADC-model-inspired rules on cross-border data transfers, which it says need modern adequacy tools; no date given for the statement, so the 2025-10-31 publication date is used.
